page.overview:
Who is Brianna?

Brianna was a Human Jedi apprentice who served as a crew member of the freighter Blind Luck during the Galactic Civil War.

By the time of the Galactic Civil War, Brianna was traveling aboard the Blind Luck, a small freighter. Despite her youth and position as a Jedi-in-training, Brianna served as a unifying presence aboard the ship.

When the Blind Luck exited hyperspace into the Elrood Sector, Brianna was among the first to recognize the transition.

Brianna exhibited the classic characteristics of a Jedi learner—disciplined, observant, and courageous—but was distinguished by her warmth and enthusiasm. Her interpersonal skills often diffused tension aboard the freighter, and even the stern Desric Fol and volatile Klag responded positively to her and she was viewed as the glue that held the crew together.
